question: Shariatullah Khan was a part of the ______ against the British.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Farazi/Faraizi Movement.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Shariatullah Khan was a part of the Farazi/Faraizi Movement against the British.**
 
• Faraizi movement was a 19th-century Islamist revivalist movement.
